name: Media entity GoogleDocs
description: Adds a Google Docs media source that parses published Google Docs embed URLs/iframes and renders them as an iframe formatter.
project_description:
This module provides a GoogleDocs integration (i.e. media source

provider plugin) for Media entities.

 

 Note: 1.x versions are compatible with Media Entity and have to be used with Drupal 8.3 and lower only. Since Drupal 8.4, Media is now part of Drupal core and 4.x branch of this module mist be used.
